name: WorkflowVersionLineage

states.name: Version Timeline
states.description: Users need a timeline of workflow versions showing version numbers, what triggered each version (generation, reflection, manual edit, fix), and when it was created.

states.name: Version Diff Summaries
states.description: Users need diff summaries explaining what changed between versions to understand workflow evolution without reading raw JSON.

states.name: Trigger Type Color Coding
states.description: Trigger types are color-coded: green for generation, purple for reflection, blue for manual, orange for fix.

states.name: Selection, Loading, and Empty States

requiredElements.text: Select a workflow to view version history

states.description: When no workflow is selected or no versions exist, clear messages guide the user.

states.name: Version Data Rendering
states.description: Each version node must accurately render the version number, trigger type badge, formatted timestamp, and diff summary text from the API response.

states.name: Version Timeline Behavior

requiredElements.text: Select a workflow to view version history

states.description: The version timeline scrolls when versions exceed the visible area, and requires a workflow to be selected via the execution context before displaying data.
states.precondition: No workflow is selected in the execution context

description: Workflow Version Lineage — shows how a workflow evolved over time through generations, reflection fixes, and manual edits, with version numbers, trigger types, timestamps, and diff summaries.
